Our Story

From our packing unit in Abupur to your kitchen

The Figo story

Figo is the edible oil brand of Siddhi Enterprises, packed at our own unit in Abupur, Modinagar, Ghaziabad.

We sell Figo directly to families, with no dealers and no middlemen in between. You order online, and your oil comes from us to your door.

Today we make three oils: Kacchi Ghani Mustard Oil, Soyabean Oil and Rice Bran Oil, each in a sealed 1 litre bottle, with 1 litre pouches too. Every pack carries our FSSAI licence number and is never sold loose.

More oils are on the way, and we would love to hear which one you want next.

About Siddhi Enterprises

Siddhi Enterprises manufactures and packs the Figo range of edible oils from Abupur, Modinagar, Ghaziabad. Our goal is simple: good oil at a fair price for every home, ordered online and delivered to your door.

Questions & Answers

How do I order?

Add your oils to the cart, enter your delivery details and tap Place Order. Your order opens in WhatsApp, and our team confirms it with you.

How do I pay?

We confirm the payment options with you on WhatsApp when we confirm your order.

What are the delivery charges and time?

These depend on your pincode. We tell you before we dispatch your order.

My pack arrived damaged. What should I do?

Message us on WhatsApp with a photo as soon as you receive it, and we will help you.

How should I store the oil?

Keep it in a cool, dry and hygienic place, away from sunlight.

Is Figo oil FSSAI approved?

Yes. Our FSSAI licence number is 12726052000641 and it is printed on every pack.

When will the other oils launch?

Soon. Message us on WhatsApp and we will let you know when your favourite oil is ready.
